messages:
Avery: heads up, sample-app CI started failing on the toolcall integration test after the latest node sdk patch. python sdk still green.
Ravi: what failure are you seeing? paste the test output?
Avery: minimal repro: schema expects {type: object, properties: {op: {type: string}, meta: {type: object}}, required: [op]}
Avery: tool returns {op: 'create'} from server. node sdk test passes because helper injects meta: {} before schema validate. python sdk does strict validate and errors on missing meta.
Lina: that sounds like defaulting behavior we added during the compact-response fix. we thought it would reduce user errors.
Noah: users normally prefer non-mutating SDKs though. defaulting on client can hide server bugs. we should be explicit.
Ravi: agreed. quick question: is this happening in jsonmode + fn_call only or across text generation too?
Avery: confirmed only in jsonmode tool responses. node helper path `sdk/lib/response-normalizers/defaults.js` is where meta is injected.
Lina: i can reproduce locally. failing assertion: expected object.meta to be undefined but got {} after normalization. py stays strict.
Noah: proposed fix: 1) revert auto-defaulting in node runtime, 2) publish a small helper `sdk.normalizeToolResponse(res, {defaults: true})` for opt-in, 3) add parity test in CI that runs both sdks against a simple fixture so we catch this earlier.
Ravi: +1. also add a short doc note in devex: "SDK helpers may normalize shapes; prefer server-side contracts for required fields" and show the helper example.
Avery: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/497 with stacktrace, test failure and suggested patch.
ci-bot: test run #8423 failed on `node-integration-toolcall` (see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/8423)
Lina: i'll prepare the revert PR for node helper and include the new opt-in helper and tests. assigning to @Ravi for review.
Ravi: thanks, adding review slot today. once merged i'll bump the SDK patch and trigger full integration run.
Noah: leaving this pinned as a compatibility note in the sample-app README until the SDK release lands.
Avery: thanks everyone  this was a subtle one — defaulting felt nice but broke parity. will remove the node pin after release.
